verdict: CLOSE ONLY THE CLASSICAL INSERTED-1D BALANCED-EVEN-M FIXED-REGULATOR CONTROLLER-FREE D-K-D HISTORY INTERTWINER; RETAIN QUANTUM MIXED-CUT, STATE/ENERGY-SELECTION, 1D-TO-3D, REGULATOR, CONTINUUM/HADAMARD, C6, CP1, AND PRE-A GATES
statement: On the explicitly inserted one-dimensional per-unit-transverse-area CL8 regulator, the inherited nonlinear D-K-D map is exactly and globally conjugate, for every nonzero step, to a two-slice history-field recurrence with the full Q3 force and no controller or added degree of freedom. Splitting the recurrence over the two spacetime parities produces an explicit staggered A/B quad equation on 16-dimensional vertex legs. For kappa nonzero every corner is recovered by a global polynomial formula; every monotone cut of an open rectangle is therefore a sweep-independent global polynomial diffeomorphism. On a balanced M/2 by M/2 rectangle, periodic endpoint identification gives exactly M history legs and every cut covers every ring site once. A discrete symplectic-current divergence identity makes the cut maps symplectic and nondegenerate. The two alternating checkerboard phases P_m^- and P_m^+ decode consecutive history pairs and toggle under exact commuting quad flips, giving J_m^+ B_m^-=F_delta J_m^- and J_(m+2)^- B_m^+=F_delta J_m^+. This closes only the classical inserted-1D balanced-even-M fixed-regulator controller-free D-K-D history intertwiner. Independently, exact bond flow, D-K-D macroblock and midpoint-quad comparisons isolate three broader route obstructions; quantum mixed-cut implementation, state and energy-reference selection, the 1D-to-3D bridge and continuum physics remain open.

model_scope.selected_branch: the inserted one-dimensional transverse-zero, per-unit-transverse-area CL8 model with w=a/8; not the original three-dimensional ST8/Q3LOCK regulator
model_scope.domain: M even and M>=4, L>0, a=L/M, w=a/8, mu=chi*w, chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>0, r real, hbar>0; bond time t is real
model_scope.canonical_leg: q_j,p_j in R^8 with p_j=w*Pi_j and Omega_leg=sum_e dp_(j,e) wedge dq_(j,e)
model_scope.inserted_data: the one-dimensional reduction, finite regulator, checkerboard schedule, time step, hbar and any null or characteristic interpretation remain inserted

exact_DKD_history_conjugacy.step_domain: delta is real and nonzero; s=delta/(2*mu)
exact_DKD_history_conjugacy.inherited_DKD: F_delta=D_(delta/2) after K_delta after D_(delta/2), where D_h(q,p)=(q+h*p/mu,p) and K_delta(q,p)=(q,p-delta*grad U_a(q))
exact_DKD_history_conjugacy.exact_conjugacy: C_delta after F_delta after C_delta^(-1) maps (x_minus,x_plus) to (x_plus,2*x_plus-x_minus-(delta^2/mu)*grad U_a(x_plus))
exact_DKD_history_conjugacy.history_symplectic_form: with C_delta:X_phase->X_hist and the repository convention Omega_phase=sum dp wedge dq, Omega_hist=(mu/delta)sum dx_plus wedge dx_minus satisfies C_delta^*Omega_hist=Omega_phase; equivalently (C_delta^(-1))^*Omega_phase=Omega_hist
exact_DKD_history_conjugacy.dimension_and_image: C_delta is a global linear bijection from the canonical 16M-dimensional phase space to two unconstrained consecutive 8M-dimensional history slices; there is no complement, quotient, radical or ancilla
exact_DKD_history_conjugacy.causal_result: one exact D-K-D step has a radius-one history recurrence; every outer star coefficient is I_8 or kappa*I_8 and is invertible when c*delta is nonzero
exact_DKD_history_conjugacy.CFL_one_form: at kappa=1, equivalently delta=a*sqrt(chi/c), the linear central coefficient vanishes and the stencil becomes a nonlinear four-outer-leg star sourced by the central Q3 field
exact_DKD_history_conjugacy.CFL_boundary: kappa=1 is an inserted regulator/time-step tuning, not a derivation of physical time, nullness or the speed of light
exact_DKD_history_conjugacy.star_to_quad: the five-point recurrence becomes one explicit two-field quad after the even-even A and odd-odd B history sublattices are paired; no new field is added because A and B are the two consecutive history slices already present in C_delta
exact_DKD_history_conjugacy.physical_boundary: the graph is an exact discrete causal representation of the selected D-K-D map, but its null, Lorentzian or physical-light-cone interpretation is not derived

staggered_AB_quad_intertwiner.coordinates: A_(i,j)=x_(i+j,i-j) and B_(i,j)=x_(i+j+1,i-j) on the spatial universal cover, followed by the periodic quotient when declared
staggered_AB_quad_intertwiner.derivation: the A equation is the history recurrence at the B_SW-centered star and the B equation is the next history recurrence at the A_NE-centered star; hence the quad is exactly the inherited D-K-D recurrence rather than a new discretization
staggered_AB_quad_intertwiner.global_corner_inverses: SW is recovered by solving the B equation for B_SW and then the A equation for A_SW; NW or SE is recovered componentwise by division by kappa. All formulas are polynomial over the fixed nonzero parameter kappa, with no field-dependent branch
staggered_AB_quad_intertwiner.SW_NE_cross_jacobian: holding NW and SE, dZ_NE/dZ_SW=[[-I,F],[-G,-I+G*F]], where F=2*(1-kappa)I-beta*Hess W_Q3(B_SW) and G=2*(1-kappa)I-beta*Hess W_Q3(A_NE)
staggered_AB_quad_intertwiner.cross_determinants: det(dZ_NE/dZ_SW)=1 and det(dZ_NE/dZ_NW)=det(dZ_NE/dZ_SE)=kappa^16; F and G are symmetric, so the SW-to-NE block is symplectic for the history leg form
staggered_AB_quad_intertwiner.open_rectangle: row-zero plus column-zero A/B vertex data determine every cell by induction; every topological sweep agrees, and each of the binomial(m+n,m) monotone paths with m+n+1 vertices is related by a global polynomial diffeomorphism
staggered_AB_quad_intertwiner.all_cut_boundary: each local path flip replaces SW by NE while retaining NW and SE; exact corner inverses make every flip reversible. Cut symplecticity uses the discrete current rather than an unsupported product-form assertion

discrete_symplectic_current.local_divergence: K_t(n,j)-K_t(n-1,j)-K_x(n,j)+K_x(n,j-1)=0 on every solution of the linearized full-Q3 history recurrence; the symmetric Q3 Hessian cancels exactly
discrete_symplectic_current.cut_form: for a closed monotone cut with history edge Z_(n_l,l) and Delta_l=n_(l+1)-n_l in {+1,-1}, Omega_C=sum_l K_t(n_l,l)+sum_(Delta_l=+1)K_x(n_l+1,l)-sum_(Delta_l=-1)K_x(n_l,l). It is invariant under every valley/cell flip by the local divergence telescope and reduces to Omega_hist on a consecutive-time Cauchy cut
discrete_symplectic_current.nondegeneracy: every declared cut map is a global diffeomorphism to a checkerboard reference cut whose reconstruction to two consecutive time slices is bijective; pulling back the nondegenerate Omega_hist therefore leaves no radical

balanced_periodic_seam.domain: M is even, m=n=M/2, and the A/B quad is placed on the m by m square in the spatial universal cover
balanced_periodic_seam.endpoint_identity: the NW endpoint (0,m) and SE endpoint (m,0) both have history time m and spatial coordinates -m and +m, so periodicity modulo M identifies exactly one duplicate vertex
balanced_periodic_seam.dimension: every monotone path has M+1 vertices before endpoint identification and exactly M independent 16-dimensional A/B legs after it, matching the canonical 16M-dimensional ring phase space
balanced_periodic_seam.site_coverage: along every east-or-south step the spatial coordinate i-j increases by one; each closed path therefore meets every spatial residue exactly once
balanced_periodic_seam.checkerboard_reference: P_m^- alternates south then east and decodes (x_(m-1),x_m); P_m^+ alternates east then south and decodes (x_m,x_(m+1)). P_(m+2)^-=P_m^-+(1,1) decodes (x_(m+1),x_(m+2)). Each decoder is a global polynomial bijection with two consecutive history slices
balanced_periodic_seam.commuting_diagram: simultaneous nonadjacent quad flips give J_m^+ after B_m^-=F_delta after J_m^- and J_(m+2)^- after B_m^+=F_delta after J_m^+. For an arbitrary cut C evaluated at time n, J_C^[n]=C_delta^(-1) after R_n after B_(C->P_n); within one time label cut changes commute with J, while physical one-step transfers use the next time-indexed checkerboard rather than one fixed reference
balanced_periodic_seam.scope_boundary: unbalanced monodromies, odd M, arbitrary time-shift seams and quantum mixed-cut tensor factorizations are not included

exact_bond_parent.partition: sum_j h_j=H_a=T_a+U_a exactly on the periodic ring
exact_bond_parent.flow: phi_j^t=exp(t*X_(h_j)); phi_j^0=Id and phi_j^t is a complete global symplectic diffeomorphism for every real t
exact_bond_parent.completeness_reason: g>0 gives a positive quartic term in every field coordinate, lambda>0 is nonnegative, r is lower order, and the positive kinetic term makes every bond energy sublevel compact
exact_bond_parent.controller_status: no passive G, ancilla, hidden force, or extra coefficient is inserted

compact_short_time_twist.uniform_compact_result: for every fixed compact phase set K there is epsilon_K>0 such that both opposite-leg blocks are invertible for every z in K and 0<|t|<epsilon_K
compact_short_time_twist.local_boundary_result: on every finite open acyclic rectangle, a sufficiently small nonzero time gives a neighborhood of the zero solution on which all declared mixed cut maps are unique local symplectic diffeomorphisms
compact_short_time_twist.boundary: epsilon_K is not cutoff-uniform or field-global, the determinant vanishes like t^32, and no global mixed inverse or arbitrary periodic seam follows

harmonic_caustic_no_go.linearized_block: per species B(t)=[R_(omega_plus)(t)-R_(omega_minus)(t)]/2 with the common bond mass m_b
harmonic_caustic_no_go.witness: at the full Q3 zero equilibrium choose r=4*c/(3*a^2), so omega_minus=2*omega_plus; at t=2*pi/omega_plus both rotations are the identity and B(t)=0
harmonic_caustic_no_go.conclusion: the declared parameter family has no global all-field, all-time exact-bond-flow sideways theorem
harmonic_caustic_no_go.survivors: compact short-time charts, nonresonant domains, restricted data, other common parents and forward temporal evolution

checkerboard_and_trotter.even_odd: H_E=sum_(j even)h_j and H_O=sum_(j odd)h_j; disjoint bonds factor within each layer and H_E+H_O=H_a
checkerboard_and_trotter.finite_circuit: F_t=Phi_O^t after Phi_E^t is an exact controller-free finite-depth symplectic Floquet circuit; its quantum counterpart is U_F(t)=exp(-i*t*H_O/hbar) exp(-i*t*H_E/hbar)
checkerboard_and_trotter.shared_local_parent: the same phi_j^t or exp(-i*t*hhat_j/hbar) is used at every periodic checkerboard bond and every forward open-rectangle vertex
checkerboard_and_trotter.forward_transport: temporal and west-plus-south forward cut maps are global; B(H) unitaries and normal-density transport are exact in the forward direction
checkerboard_and_trotter.classical_limit: for fixed M and a compact finite-time trajectory tube, (F_(T/n))^n converges locally uniformly to Phi_(H_a)^T
checkerboard_and_trotter.quantum_limit: the form-sum Lie-Trotter product converges strongly to exp(-i*T*Hhat_a/hbar)
checkerboard_and_trotter.finite_step_obstruction: overlapping bonds have a nonzero Poisson bracket, so a finite nonzero checkerboard step is not the exact inherited autonomous flow or the inherited D-K-D map
checkerboard_and_trotter.schedule_boundary: the checkerboard ordering is still a chosen discrete schedule and not a derived physical clock or exact boundary-Cauchy diagram

dkd2_macro_route.positive_finding: at any static tangent point, two inherited D-K-D steps have an invertible adjacent 16-by-16 cross block with determinant [delta^4*k^2/mu^2]^8, so the one-step rank-eight obstruction does not survive macroblocking
dkd2_macro_route.spectator_witness: the distance-two position-to-momentum derivative contains delta^3*k^2/mu and is nonzero
dkd2_macro_route.conclusion: the direct identification of F_delta^2 with a two-input/two-output same-16-dimensional-leg vertex is false because its output also depends on radius-two spectators
dkd2_macro_route.survivors: halo or ancilla constructions, larger legs, constrained quotients, nonlocal evaluation maps and other macrocell factorizations

light_cone_quad_routes.explicit_quad: q_11=q_10+q_01-q_00-alpha*grad W_Q3(q_00), alpha=Delta_u*Delta_v/(4*chi), gives global forward q-only reconstruction
light_cone_quad_routes.explicit_boundary: one null leg carries q in R^8 rather than an independent canonical q,p leg in R^16; p=w*chi*q_t combines both null derivatives and no exact finite-U_a canonical intertwiner is proved
light_cone_quad_routes.midpoint_witness: with three corners zero and q_11=y*1_8 the equation is y*[1+alpha*r/4+alpha*g*y^2/64]=0; for r<0, alpha=-4/r is singular and alpha>-4/r yields three real roots
light_cone_quad_routes.survivors: the explicit q-only quad, local implicit branches, constrained phase lifts and separately justified variational discretizations

cut_energy_ledger.definition: for every admitted cut C with its time-indexed canonical decoder J_C^[n], define E_C^[n]=H_a after J_C^[n]
cut_energy_ledger.same_history_cut_identity: if C and D represent the same history state at label n, E_D^[n] after B_(C->D)=E_C^[n]
cut_energy_ledger.translated_cut_identity: for a one-step transfer, E_D^[n+1] after B_(C->D)-E_C^[n]=(H_a after F_delta-H_a) after J_C^[n]
cut_energy_ledger.defect_name: the right-hand side is the exact finite-D-K-D energy defect
cut_energy_ledger.measure_transport: (J_D^[n+1])_* (B_(C->D))_* nu_C=(F_delta)_* (J_C^[n])_* nu_C for every supplied measure nu_C
cut_energy_ledger.boundary: E_P is a transported coordinate ledger. The finite-D-K-D defect need not vanish; no positive locally cut-additive invariant, stationary measure, physical energy zero, vacuum normalization or below-empty-space comparison is established

boundary_cauchy_contract.chosen_parent: the exact inherited nonlinear D-K-D map in its globally conjugate two-slice history representation
boundary_cauchy_contract.diagram_scope: classical, fixed inserted-1D regulator, nonzero delta and c, open monotone cuts and the balanced even-M periodic seam
boundary_cauchy_contract.reason: the exact canonical/history conjugacy, staggered quad derivation, global corner inverses, balanced seam and current-flux telescope together define bijective symplectic evaluation maps with no unused complement
boundary_cauchy_contract.dimension: canonical Cauchy data, two consecutive history slices and every balanced periodic A/B cut have 16M real dimensions with no complement, quotient radical or ancilla
boundary_cauchy_contract.energy: E_C^[n]=H_a after J_C^[n] gives an exact shared time-indexed cut ledger. Same-history cut changes preserve it by coordinate transport, while a physical one-step cut transfer has the exact defect (H_a after F_delta-H_a) after J_C^[n]. The defect is not asserted to vanish, and no common positive cut-additive invariant or physical reference is proved
boundary_cauchy_contract.state: forward densities transport exactly, but no stationary, preferred, physical, vacuum or below-empty-space state is selected

No new general theorem or world-first claim is made. The repository-specific contribution is the exact inserted-1D CL8/Q3 normalization and symplectic-sign audit plus the scoped comparison of its inherited D-K-D history conjugacy, controller-free bond flow, D-K-D macroblocking and Q3 light-cone candidates under one boundary-Cauchy contract.
no_overclaim: This package proves only an exact classical fixed-regulator conjugacy of the inherited nonlinear D-K-D map to a two-slice Q3 history recurrence, an exact staggered A/B quad with global corner inverses, open-rectangle all-cut diffeomorphisms, a balanced even-M periodic seam, discrete symplectic cut flux and a commuting classical boundary-Cauchy dynamics diagram on the inserted one-dimensional regulator, together with the separately scoped bond-flow and route-negative comparisons. It does not prove an unbalanced or odd-M seam, quantum mixed-cut algebra or unitary reshuffling, a common positive invariant, stationary or selected physical state, original three-dimensional Q3LOCK dynamics, physical empty space or a below-empty-space sign, cutoff-uniform reconstruction, regulator removal, a continuum or Hadamard state, derived hbar, physical time, nullness, Lorentzian signature or light speed, a phase transition or cooling, full 3+1 dynamics, gravity, a horizon or cycle, C0 or N1-N5 closure, C6 advancement, CP1 completion, or Pre-A completion.
